clauses.scope_note: CC BY 4.0 §2(a)(5), Licensed Material. Each recipient automatically receives an offer from the Licensor to exercise Licensed Rights under the Public License terms.
clauses.condition_explanation: recipient_of_licensed_material means a person who receives the Licensed Material. The offer is subject to the Public License terms and conditions; this clause does not itself impose a duty on the recipient.

clauses.scope_note: CC BY 4.0 §2(a)(5), Licensed Material. Prohibits offering or imposing additional or different terms, or applying Effective Technological Measures, only when they restrict a recipient's exercise of Licensed Rights.
clauses.condition_explanation: terms_or_measures_restrict_recipient_exercise_of_licensed_rights means the licensee offers or imposes additional or different terms or conditions on, or applies Effective Technological Measures to, the Licensed Material, and those terms or measures restrict a recipient's exercise of Licensed Rights.

obligation_items.content: Do not offer or impose additional or different terms or conditions on, or apply Effective Technological Measures to, the Licensed Material if doing so restricts a recipient's exercise of Licensed Rights.
obligation_items.trigger: When offering or imposing terms or conditions on, or applying Effective Technological Measures to, the Licensed Material that restrict a recipient's exercise of Licensed Rights.

clauses.condition_explanation: asserts_or_implies_connection_sponsorship_endorsement_or_official_status means representing that You or Your use of the Licensed Material has one of the stated relationships or statuses. obligation_items.content: Do not assert or imply that You or Your use of the Licensed Material is connected with, sponsored or endorsed by, or granted official status by the Licensor or persons designated to receive attribution under §3(a)(1)(A)(i).
obligation_items.trigger: When asserting or implying one of the stated relationships or statuses concerning You or Your use of the Licensed Material.
